第三章 开启，英雄神典
秦云天眉宇间满是焦急，额头渗出丝丝汗珠，看着眼前那扇紧闭的房门，身为凝神镜强者的他竟然不知该如何是好，他很想推开进去，可是理智却不允许他这么做。
“没事的，会没事的。”
口中呢喃着，秦云天深深吸了一口凉气，守在房前，体内的玄气缓缓流动着，目光迥然，紧紧的盯着那扇木门。
幽暗的屋内，少年的身影躺在床上不断的抽搐着，脸上有着一抹不健康的涨红，牙齿紧咬，一丝猩红自嘴角滑落，显得极为刺眼。
“该死，这次怎么会这么严重！”
心中咆哮着，秦轩只感觉身体快不是自己的了，这种情况已经持续了快七年了，这也是为何秦云天守在外面不进来的原因，因为这种痛只能他自己解决，其他人根本没办法，只不过以往最多疼一会罢了，而且程度根本没这般恐怖，像这种痛入骨髓还是第一次！
“吼！”
口中发出一丝类似兽吼的声音，秦轩那双本就通红的眼眸越来越红，最后就如灌入了鲜血一般，身上更是散发着一股恐怖的杀气，若是秦云天此时闯进来一定会惊讶的发现，这股杀气恐怕连常年征战的军人都不及，这得杀多少人啊！
蓦地，恐怖的杀气毫无预兆的蹦散，紧接着，自秦轩那血红的双眼射出一道红芒，红芒如血，很快便在半空凝聚成一诡异的竖眼，一股若有若无的威压散发开来，令人感到压抑。
血红的竖眼居高临下的扫视着少年，就仿佛高高在上的神灵看着一只蝼蚁一般，然而这一切对于此刻的秦轩来说，根本无心理会，甚至连这些异象都没发现，他只觉得自己的灵魂仿佛要被抽离一般，甚至觉得有什么东西从自己的胸口爬出来，意识也渐渐的模糊起来。
也不知过了多久，或许有一世纪那么长，又或许仅仅几秒钟，当秦轩醒过来后，发现自己竟是站在一道巨大的铁门前，铁门至少有百米高，数十米宽，整体为朱红色，表面锈迹斑斑，显然已经有些岁月了，特别是当秦轩走进后，更是觉得一股厚重古老的气息迎面扑来。
立在门前，秦轩只觉得自己犹如一个站在巨人面前的蚂蚁，随时都有被毁灭的可能。
这时，巨大的铁门上突然燃烧起血色火焰，毫无预兆的，更是有一股澎湃的冲天杀意扑向秦轩，一时间，秦轩仿佛自己陷入了修罗炼狱一般，脚下流淌的是滚烫的血液，周围到处是残肢断臂，尸横遍野，更是有惨叫声不断的传入耳内。
凄厉，痛苦，绝望！
“滚开！”
怒吼一声，秦轩坚守心神，摒弃杂念，神念化成一柄锋利无比的利剑直接朝前方劈去，勇往直前，无所畏惧！
就好像玻璃破碎，周围的一切瞬间被劈得粉碎，一切又恢复了原先模样，惨叫声也消失得无影无踪，一切就如没发生过一般。
然而事情还没结束，由神念化成的利剑余势不减，直奔那扇巨大的铁门，誓要将其劈成两半！
“我倒要看看你这是什么鬼东西，给我开！”又是一声怒吼，利用剩余的力量，又是一柄有神念化成的利剑紧随而至。

两柄利剑，一前一后，带着无可匹敌的气势直指巨大铁门！
气势如虹！
轰隆隆！
第一柄利剑刚碰触到巨门，整个巨门开始剧烈的摇晃起来，门上的火焰也随之晃动，天上顿时下起了火雨，空气瞬间变得炽热干燥起来。
“差一点点，开！”
秦轩并没有因为周围的变化而变化，目光死死的盯着那扇铁门，脸色狰狞，眉宇间有些微的紧张，紧接着，又是一股能量朝着第二柄利剑灌输而去，做完这一切后，便整个人瘫倒在地。
仿佛天崩地裂，世界末日一般，整片天地一阵晃动，秦轩更是觉得耳边一片轰鸣，眼前被一道血色光芒笼罩，使得忍不住闭上了双眼。
血色光芒逐渐消退，当秦轩重新睁开双眼后，眼前还是除了那扇巨大铁门外别无他物，不同的是，铁门上的血色火焰已经熄灭了，铁门大开！
见此，秦轩不禁一喜，虽然他还不清楚怎么回事，但是他隐约猜到，这绝对与他这七年来疼痛离不开关系。
轻轻一跃，少年便轻松来到巨大的铁门门口，在那里，是一片仿若宇宙的星云，他甚至能看到一个个小型的黑洞和星球。
“这……”
一阵愕然，令他怎么想也想不到会是这样的一副情景，这已经超出了他认知的范围，一个宇宙竟然藏在一扇铁门的身后？
“坑爹啊！靠！”震撼过后，秦轩便一声怒骂，脸上充满了愤然，本以为自己遇到了什么际遇，可是没想到竟是这种情况，这如何能不让他愤怒！
宇宙？黑洞？星球？这关他什么事啊，如果自己不是从地球穿越过来的，这里的人会知道这些东西吗？
再者，就算这扇门包囊了这个宇宙，那又怎样？这么大一扇门，难道自己能搬走不成？最重要的是，自己要怎么离开这个鬼地方！
“你大爷的！”越想越气愤，秦轩提起拳头猛然朝着那门后的‘宇宙’轰击而去，可接下来秦轩就后悔，甚至惊恐！
抽不出来！竟然抽不出来了！整条手臂被‘宇宙’包裹着，任他如何用力，如何使劲，却仿佛陷入了沼泽一般，丝毫起不到任何作用，反而越陷越深！
“尼玛，前世小说那些穿越的主角不是坐拥江山，左拥右抱，就是实力强绝，舍我其谁，可是到了自己，怎么这么倒霉？”
秦轩顿时有些想哭，这反差也太大了，不过不等他多想，那只陷入‘宇宙’的手臂上突然传来剧烈的疼痛，好像有人要硬生生的将其撕裂一样，这也令其忍不住痛吼出来。
汗水，早已布满了他的额头，如果可以，他宁愿就这样死掉，这太折磨人了！

就在秦轩快要绝望的时候，只听啵的一声，仿佛手指好不容易从瓶子抽出来的声音一般，陷入‘宇宙’的那条手臂也终于抽离了开来，秦轩整个人也在毫无准备之下，跌了出去。
“出来了？”秦轩愣了愣，有些不明所以，但是当目光落在那条手臂上的时候，又是一喜，“幸亏还在！”
忍不住松了口气，秦轩心中依旧心有余悸，不过他也终于知道，这扇古怪的巨门对他似乎没什么恶意。
“这是？”
这时，他突然发现那只陷入‘宇宙’的手中不知何时多了一本古老的书籍，整本书籍呈暗红色，表面有金色镶边，一道道青色的能量在上面缓缓流动着，如波澜一样，而这本书更像是有某种魔力一般，当秦轩看了第一眼后，便怎么也无法抽离视线。
“呼。”
过了许久，秦轩才从那种莫名的感觉中回过神来，除了脸色有些苍白外，双眼迸射出一道兴奋的光芒，就在刚才，他明显发现自己体内流动的玄气竟是畅通了不少，这对于一个废了七层经脉的人来说，简直是不可思议！
目光痴痴的望着手中的古老书籍，秦轩并没发现那道巨大的铁门早已消失了，而他也回到了自己的房间内。
“英雄神典？”
翻开书籍的第一页，只见四个金色大字映入眼帘，字迹苍劲有力，龙飞凤舞，更是透着一股淡淡的威压，令人为之震撼侧目，紧随着，秦轩的脑海里更是多了一股信息。
直到第二天天亮，秦轩才将这股信息彻底消化，而现在的他，脸上尽是激动与兴奋，身体微微颤抖着，脸色也有些红润，看着手中的‘英雄神典’就如盯着一名绝世美女般。
“英，英雄联盟！”

Chapter 3: Opening, the Heroic Codex
Qin Yuntian's brows were filled with anxiety, and beads of sweat oozed from his forehead. He looked at the closed door in front of him. As a strong concentrating mirror, he didn't know what to do. He wanted to push it open and go in, but his reason did not allow him to do so.
"It's okay, it'll be okay."
Whispering in his mouth, Qin Yuntian took a deep breath and stood guard in front of the room. The profound energy in his body flowed slowly, and his eyes were fixed on the wooden door.
In the dark room, the young man's figure was lying on the bed, twitching continuously, with an unhealthy flush on his face. His teeth were clenched, and a trace of scarlet slipped from the corner of his mouth, which looked extremely dazzling.
"Damn it, how could it be so serious this time!"
Roaring in his heart, Qin Xuan only felt that his body was no longer his. This situation had been going on for almost seven years. This was the reason why Qin Yuntian stayed outside and refused to come in. Because he could only deal with this kind of pain, and no one else could do anything about it. In the past, it only hurt for a while at most, and the degree was not so terrifying. This was the first time that this kind of pain penetrated into the bone marrow!
"Roar!"
There was a sound similar to a beast's roar from his mouth, and Qin Xuan's already red eyes became redder and redder. Finally, it was as if they were filled with blood, and his body exuded a terrifying murderous aura. If Qin Yuntian broke in at this time, he would be surprised to find that this murderous aura is probably not as good as that of soldiers who have been fighting all year round. How many people would have to be killed!
Suddenly, the terrifying murderous intent dissipated without warning, and then, a red light shot out from Qin Xuan's blood-red eyes. The red light was like blood, and soon condensed into a strange vertical eye in mid-air. A vague pressure spread out, which made people feel depressed.
The blood-red vertical eyes scanned the young man condescendingly, as if a superior god was looking at an ant. However, Qin Xuan had no understanding of all this at this moment. He did not even notice these strange phenomena. He only felt as if his soul was about to be pulled away. He even felt that something was crawling out of his chest, and his consciousness gradually became blurred.
I don’t know how long it took, maybe as long as a century, or maybe just a few seconds. When Qin Xuan woke up, he found that he was standing in front of a huge iron gate. The iron gate was at least a hundred meters high and dozens of meters wide.
Standing in front of the door, Qin Xuan felt like an ant standing in front of a giant, who might be destroyed at any time.
At this time, bloody flames suddenly burned on the huge iron door. Without any warning, a surging murderous intention rushed towards Qin Xuan. For a moment, Qin Xuan felt as if he had fallen into Shura purgatory. Hot blood was flowing under his feet. There were stumps and broken arms everywhere, corpses were strewn across the field, and screams were heard constantly reaching his ears.
Misery, pain, despair!
"Get away!"
Roaring angrily, Qin Xuan held on to his mind and abandoned distracting thoughts. His mind turned into an extremely sharp sword and struck directly forward, moving forward bravely without fear!
It was like glass was broken, everything around him was instantly shattered, everything returned to its original appearance, the screams disappeared without a trace, and it was as if everything had never happened.
However, the matter was not over yet. The sharp sword formed by divine thoughts continued unabated and headed straight for the huge iron door, vowing to split it in half!
"I want to see what the hell you are, shoot it!" There was another roar, and using the remaining power, another sharp sword made of spiritual thoughts followed closely.
Two sharp swords, one behind the other, pointed directly at the huge iron door with unparalleled momentum!
The momentum is like a rainbow!
Boom!
As soon as the first sharp sword touched the giant door, the entire giant door began to shake violently, the flames on the door also swayed, and suddenly it started to rain from the sky.The air suddenly became hot and dry due to the rain of fire.
"Almost, open!"
Qin Xuan did not change due to the changes around him. His eyes were fixed on the iron door, his face was ferocious, and his eyebrows were slightly nervous. Then, another energy was poured into the second sword. After doing all this, he collapsed to the ground.
As if the sky was falling apart and the world was ending, the whole world shook. Qin Xuan felt a roar in his ears, and his eyes were shrouded in a bloody light, making him unable to help but close his eyes.
The bloody light gradually faded. When Qin Xuan opened his eyes again, there was still nothing but the huge iron door in front of him. The difference was that the bloody flames on the iron door had been extinguished and the iron door was wide open!
Seeing this, Qin Xuan couldn't help but feel happy. Although he didn't know what was going on, he vaguely guessed that it was definitely related to the pain he had been having for the past seven years.
With a slight jump, the young man easily arrived at the huge iron door. There was a nebula that looked like the universe. He could even see small black holes and planets.
"This..."
There was a moment of astonishment, which made him never imagine such a scene. This was beyond the scope of his cognition. A universe was actually hidden behind an iron door?
"You're cheating! Damn!" After the shock, Qin Xuan cursed angrily, his face full of anger. He thought he had encountered something unexpected, but he didn't expect it to be like this. How could he not be angry!
universe? Black hole? Planet? What does this have to do with him? If he hadn't traveled from the earth, would the people here know these things?
Furthermore, even if this door encompasses the universe, so what? With such a big door, can't I move it by myself? The most important thing is how to get out of this hellish place!
"Your uncle!" The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. Qin Xuan raised his fist and slammed towards the 'universe' behind the door. But then Qin Xuan regretted it and was even horrified!
Can’t pull it out! I can’t even pull it out! The entire arm was wrapped in the 'universe'. No matter how hard he tried, it seemed to be stuck in a swamp. It had no effect at all, and instead fell deeper and deeper!
"Nima, the protagonists in the previous life novels who traveled through time were either sitting on the throne, hugging each other, or they were extremely powerful. Who else would it be? But when it comes to myself, why is it so unlucky?"
Qin Xuan suddenly wanted to cry. The contrast was too great, but before he could think about it, severe pain suddenly came from the arm that was stuck in the 'universe', as if someone was about to tear it apart forcefully, which made him unable to help but scream in pain.
Sweat had already covered his forehead. If possible, he would rather die like this. This is too torture!
Just when Qin Xuan was about to despair, he heard a pop, like the sound of his fingers finally being pulled out of the bottle. The arm trapped in the 'universe' finally pulled away, and Qin Xuan fell out without any preparation.
"Come out?" Qin Xuan was stunned, a little confused, but when his eyes fell on that arm, he felt happy again, "Fortunately it's still there!"
Qin Xuan couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief. Qin Xuan still had lingering fears, but he finally knew that this weird giant door didn't seem to have any ill intentions towards him.
"This is it?"
At this time, he suddenly discovered that there was an ancient book in the hand that was stuck in the "universe". The whole book was dark red with golden edges on the surface. Green energy flowed slowly on it, like waves, and this book seemed to have some kind of magic power. After Qin Xuan took a first look at it, he couldn't take his eyes away.
"Huh."
After a long time, Qin Xuan came back to his senses from that inexplicable feeling. Except for his face being a little pale, his eyes burst out with a light of excitement. Just now, he clearly found that he was feelingThe profound energy flowing inside is actually much smoother, which is simply unbelievable for a person who has lost seven layers of meridians!
Looking dreamily at the ancient book in his hand, Qin Xuan did not realize that the huge iron door had disappeared long ago, and he also returned to his room.
"Heroes' Codex?"
Opening the first page of the book, only four large golden characters came into view. The handwriting was vigorous and powerful, with dragons and phoenixes dancing, and there was a faint coercion, which made people shocked and raised their eyebrows. Then, Qin Xuan's mind was filled with more information.
It wasn't until dawn the next day that Qin Xuan completely digested this information. But now, his face was full of excitement and excitement, his body was trembling slightly, and his face was a little rosy. Looking at the 'Hero Dictionary' in his hand was like staring at a peerless beauty.
"Ying, League of Legends!"
